cog.privacy_body:
**Effective date:** <t:1792454400:F>

**1. What we collect**
Niko stores only what is strictly necessary to provide its features:
- **User IDs** — to link economy balances, XP, reminders, birthdays, highlights, AI memory, and warnings to you.
- **Server IDs** — to keep per-server configuration (moderation, leveling, tickets, automod, etc.).
- **Message content** — read in real time for AI replies, automod, snipe, highlights, and leveling XP; not stored permanently except for AI conversation history (last 3 exchanges, per-user), the snipe cache (last deleted/edited message per channel, cleared on restart), and the experimental MrBeast scam-image filter (see below). Daily aggregate message, join, and leave counts are stored for the dashboard without message text or member IDs.
- **User presence & status** — read to support member-list and bot-status features; not stored.
- **Voice state** — used only during active music or VoiceMaster sessions; not stored.
- **Scam-image filter (experimental)** — when a member reports a message via the right-click scam report, the reported images and message context are sent to Niko staff for review. On confirmation, a perceptual hash (a compact numeric fingerprint) and a copy of the image are stored so variants can be detected and removed automatically. Nothing is stored for servers without the filter enabled.
- **Premium image moderation** — on a server with an active premium subscription, the URL of each image attachment posted there is sent to fal.ai's NSFW model so it can be scored. Niko stores the verdict (confidence score, file name, and moderation action), not the image itself. Nothing is sent for servers without premium.
- **Payments** — premium subscriptions and donations are processed by OxaPay. We store the order reference, OxaPay payment reference, the Discord user and server the payment belongs to, the amount and currency, the chosen crypto asset, the deposit address shown at checkout, and the payment status and timestamps. Niko never receives or stores card numbers, bank details, wallet private keys, or seed phrases. Payment records are kept for accounting, fraud prevention, refund handling, and billing support, including after a subscription ends.
- **Social notifier** — if a server follows social accounts, only the account name, platform, last-seen post ID, and target channel are stored.

**2. How we use it**
All data is used exclusively to run Niko's features within Discord. We never sell, share, or transfer your data to third parties.

**3. Storage & security**
Data is stored in a database on the server hosting Niko (SQLite or MongoDB, depending on deployment). No external analytics service is used.

**4. Data retention**
Economy, leveling, and configuration data persist until you or a server admin removes it. AI conversation history is capped at your last 3 exchanges and is automatically overwritten. You may erase your own AI memory at any time with `/clearhistory`.

**5. Your rights & data removal**
You may request deletion of your account data or a server you own through the data removal form: {data_removal}
You must sign in with Discord so ownership can be confirmed. A server request remains available after Niko is removed if you were its owner at the time. Moderation and safety records are preserved: bot-level blacklists, warnings, mutes, moderation cases, logs and ticket transcripts, giveaway bans, abuse strikes, and scam-image reports. A request never lifts a restriction. If a law requires release of a preserved record, send a formal request with a court record or signed legal document and an official legal contact directly to the bot owner: {owner_contact}. These matters are confidential and handled personally.

**6. Third-party services**
When the AI feature is enabled, your message and a short anonymised context are sent to OpenAI's API to generate a reply. OpenAI's privacy policy applies to that data: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
Premium image moderation sends image URLs to fal.ai (https://fal.ai/privacy), and payments are processed by OxaPay (https://oxapay.com/privacy).
Other features may contact their respective services (e.g. social platforms for the notifier, Google Translate for translations); only the minimum data needed for the feature is shared. Niko does not sell or rent personal data and does not use it for advertising.

**7. Payments & billing support**
Payment records are retained after a subscription ends so billing questions, duplicate charges, refunds, and financial records can be handled accurately. You can ask about, or request deletion of, the personal data attached to a payment through the support server with the server ID and order reference; records we must keep for accounting or fraud prevention may be retained as long as the law requires.

**8. Changes**
Material changes to this policy will be announced in the support server. Continued use of Niko after a change constitutes acceptance.

-# Full policy: {privacy} · Questions? Join the support server: {support_server}
cog.terms_body:
**Effective date:** <t:1792454400:F>

**1. Acceptance**
By using Niko in any Discord server you agree to these Terms and Discord's own Terms of Service (https://discord.com/terms) and Community Guidelines (https://discord.com/guidelines).

**2. Permitted use**
Niko is provided for personal, non-commercial use within Discord servers. You may not use Niko to harass, spam, or harm other users, to violate any law, or to attempt to exploit, reverse-engineer, or disrupt Niko's operation.

**3. Feature availability**
Niko is provided **as-is** with no uptime guarantee. Features may be changed, restricted, or removed at any time without prior notice.

**4. Moderation & bans**
The bot operator reserves the right to blacklist any user or server from using Niko at any time and for any reason, including but not limited to abuse, exploitation, or violation of these Terms.

**5. AI-generated content**
Niko uses an AI language model to generate replies. AI output may be inaccurate, incomplete, or unexpected — always verify important information independently. The bot operator is not liable for any harm arising from AI-generated content.

**6. Economy & virtual items**
All in-bot currency and virtual items have no real-world value and cannot be exchanged for real money or goods. Virtual balances may be reset or wiped at any time.

**7. Premium subscriptions**
Niko Premium costs **$15 USD per server per month** and is billed manually: you choose to renew, and a reminder is sent before the term ends. There is no automatic recurring charge. Premium is a licence to use server features for one server and one term; it is not a sale of software, does not create a partnership or fiduciary relationship, and does not give you ownership in Niko. You must be old enough to enter a contract where you live, or have permission from a parent or guardian, to buy premium.

**8. Payments & crypto**
Payments are collected through OxaPay, a third-party payment processor. Crypto transactions are irreversible once broadcast to the network, and the crypto amount you send is set by the network and the provider's quote. You are responsible for sending the correct asset on the correct network, and for any taxes that apply to you. OxaPay's terms also apply. Never send funds to an address copied from somewhere other than the checkout page Niko shows you. If you believe a charge is wrong, contact support first; please do not start a chargeback or payment dispute for a service that was actually delivered, except where the law gives you that right.

**9. Refunds**
Premium and donations are purchases of digital services delivered immediately and are generally non-refundable. If a payment was duplicated, charged in error, or never activated, contact us through the support server and we will review it in good faith and, where appropriate, extend the term, issue a credit, or arrange a refund through the processor. Nothing here limits a mandatory consumer right you have under applicable law.

**10. Volunteer-run project**
Niko is a free, volunteer-run community project. It is not a company, partnership, registered business, or other legal entity. It is maintained by individuals in their personal capacity, in their own time, without payment from subscription revenue beyond covering service costs. No volunteer, contributor, or maintainer is your employee, agent, partner, or fiduciary, and none of them makes any personal promise about the service.

**11. Third-party services**
Niko depends on services we do not control, including Discord, OxaPay, fal.ai, and hosting providers. Outages, policy changes, or account actions on those services can interrupt or end features. We are not responsible for third-party services, and we are not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord, OxaPay, or fal.ai.

**12. Limitation of liability**
To the maximum extent permitted by law, the operator, maintainers, and volunteers are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, or for lost profits, revenue, data, goodwill, or server growth, arising from or related to Niko, premium, or any payment. Our total aggregate liability for all claims relating to a server's subscription is limited to the greater of the amount actually paid for that subscription in the three months before the claim or $15 USD. This does not limit liability that cannot be limited by law.

**13. Indemnity**
To the maximum extent permitted by law, you agree to indemnify and hold harmless the operator, maintainers, and volunteers from claims, damages, losses, and reasonable costs arising from your server's use of Niko, content posted in it, your breach of these terms, or your violation of another person's rights.

**14. Changes & discontinuation**
We may change, suspend, or discontinue Niko or premium, including a specific feature. If premium is discontinued during a paid term, we will handle the remaining term in good faith, for example by keeping the service running to the end of the term or by offering a pro-rata credit through the processor. We do not guarantee a cash refund where the law does not require one. If any provision of these terms is unenforceable, the rest stays in effect.

**15. Contact**
For questions or concerns: {support_server}
Data removal: {data_removal} · Formal legal requests: {owner_contact}

cog.community_body:
**Effective date:** <t:1792454400:F>

These community expectations apply to every server that uses Niko. By adding the bot to a server, the server's owners and administrators agree to uphold these standards, in addition to Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

**Discrimination and harassment**
Servers must not permit or promote discrimination, harassment, or hate speech targeting people based on race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or any other protected identity characteristic.

**Illegal and malicious content**
Servers must not create, host, share, or distribute illegal or malicious content. This includes, but is not limited to: child sexual abuse material (CSAM), malware and other malicious software, gore or shock content, pirated media and/or software, content that facilitates violence or terrorism, scams and phishing, and any other content that is illegal under applicable law.

**Other prohibited conduct**
Servers must not use Niko to facilitate doxxing, targeted harassment campaigns, sextortion, trafficking, or the sexualization of minors in any form.

**Enforcement and investigations**
When a server is reported or flagged for potentially violating this policy, Niko will send a warning notice to the server. The notice is followed by an investigation by Niko staff. Servers that cooperate in good faith and are found not to be breaking the policies will not receive any further action.

**Obstruction of investigations**
Banning, kicking, or otherwise removing the staff member(s) sent to investigate, or hiding, deleting, or tampering with potential evidence, is treated as an admission of guilt. Doing so will result in the server — and any users who are involved — being permanently blacklisted from further use of Niko, in addition to any other action the investigation warrants.

**Reporting**
If you believe a server using Niko is violating this policy, report it through the Niko support server. Reports are reviewed by staff and handled confidentially.

-# Full policy: {community}
